انعصرت (form VII)
# اِنْعَصَرْتُ (inʕaṣartu) /in.ʕa.sˤar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْعَصَرَ (inʕaṣara)
# اِنْعَصَرْتَ (inʕaṣarta) /in.ʕa.sˤar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْعَصَرَ (inʕaṣara)
# اِنْعَصَرْتِ (inʕaṣarti) /in.ʕa.sˤar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْعَصَرَ (inʕaṣara)
# اِنْعَصَرَتْ (inʕaṣarat) /in.ʕa.sˤa.rat/: third-pe
